purpose: Explicitly admit future NEW Route/Hosted QA implementation, workflow, and successor checkpoint paths into R3 Project Check routing before clean-room runtime implementation. Prevent MANUAL_REVIEW fallback and unintended owner fan-out while preserving RH1's read-only HTTP Hosted validation boundary.

rh3TransitionContract.condition: When the NEW Route/Hosted QA core and its self-test are introduced, add a dedicated catalogued route-hosted-qa self-test validator and replace the route-hosted-qa owner's temporary project-check-self-test validator with the dedicated validator in the same owning scope.

preserve: RH0 current OLD QA baseline and exact route/fixture/check inventory.
RH1 read-only HTTP Hosted validation boundary, strict/probe separation, and Hosted/Browser/Semantic ownership separation.
OLD QA-0/QA-1 contracts and validation evidence as frozen predecessor evidence only.
Current R1 Status Source, R2 Project Status, R3 Project Check and Regression Runner behavior.
Current frontend, semantic, canonical, relation, asset, localization and ConfigData state.
nonScope: No tools/route-hosted-qa implementation is created in RH2.
No NEW Route/Hosted QA workflow file is created or executed in RH2.
No new route-hosted-qa validator is added to the R3 validator catalog in RH2.
No package.json entrypoint is changed in RH2.
No OLD Route/Hosted QA workflow, runtime script, package alias, contract, validation artifact, or deployment writer is changed or retired in RH2.
No GitHub Pages deployment, gh-pages mutation, or force-push is performed in RH2.
No Browser/Playwright test is added in RH2.
No semantic, canonical, relation, Status Source, Project Status, frontend, asset, ConfigData, localization or Regression Runner state is mutated in RH2.

reviews.detail: The dedicated route-hosted-qa owner is admitted, but its validator is intentionally the existing project-check-self-test until RH3 creates the NEW Route/Hosted QA core self-test. RH3 must replace this temporary validator rather than leaving it as the final owner model.
The OLD strict hosted-proof workflow still has a historical deployment-writer role. RH2 does not change or inherit that role; retirement remains a later shadow/cutover/closeout task.

nextStart: RH3: install the clean-room tools/route-hosted-qa core, contracts, CLI and self-test under the RH1 read-only HTTP boundary; add a dedicated catalogued route-hosted-qa self-test validator and replace the RH2 temporary project-check-self-test owner validator without expanding into deployment writes, Browser/UI, semantic, asset, or frontend ownership.
reopenConditions: RH1 boundary or RH0 predecessor evidence changes before clean-room core installation.
Any of the three admitted NEW path families routes to MANUAL_REVIEW or an unintended owner.
R3 owner-map or validator-catalog policy changes before RH3 implementation.
NEW Route/Hosted QA is required to mutate deployment state, repository state, semantic data, frontend state, or assets.
Authoritative Hosted QA route, fixture, check-ID, base-path, source-SHA, or failure-ownership contracts change.
